    Questions about peptides for weight loss

    What are the best peptides for weight loss?

    Two weekly shots are FDA approved for weight management, semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound), both on prescription. The options on this page: Semaglutide (Wegovy), weekly shot for weight loss; Tirzepatide (Zepbound), weekly shot for weight loss; Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide, pharmacy-made shot; Retatrutide, experimental shot, still in trials.

    Are peptides for weight loss FDA approved?

    FDA approved: Semaglutide (Wegovy) and Tirzepatide (Zepbound). Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made: Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide. Not approved; still in trials: Retatrutide. Each status has its source under "Is it legal today?".

    How much do peptides for weight loss cost?

    Semaglutide (Wegovy): online clinics from $199/mo (NovoCare Pharmacy). Tirzepatide (Zepbound): online clinics from $349/mo (ShedRx). Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide: online clinics from $49/mo (Embody). Retatrutide: from $0.60/mg at 10 shops. Prices checked 8 Nov 2026.

    Do I need a prescription for peptides for weight loss?

    On prescription: Semaglutide (Wegovy), Tirzepatide (Zepbound) and Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide. Research use only: Retatrutide.
